chapter_note: A heavily substrate chapter mapping the eighteen cosmic thrones — nine outer (in the aeons of greatness) and nine inner (in this cosmos / Half-Region). The enumeration is systematic and cosmological: Father, Mother of Life, First Man, Beloved of Lights, Great Builder, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus Radiance, Great Splendor (gathering point); then within the cosmos: Ambassador, Great One of Spirit, Living Spirit (in day-ship), Jesus Radiance, First Man, Light (in night-ship), Great King of Honor (7th firmament), Judge of Truth (air), and ninth — which the editor maps onto "the apostle in the holy Church... who has come unto our feet at this time." This 18th throne is a clear editorial extension by pattern mimicry: the ninth inner slot is filled with the contemporary Manichaean apostolic institution rather than a cosmic figure. The closing doxology "unto the eternity of eternities. Amen" at i=44 is also editorial. Otherwise the chapter is overwhelmingly substrate enumeration, including the question/dialogue frame at i=3 which contains substantive cosmological content ("Eight [thrones]"). Heavy lacunae throughout (60.9% damage).
